The drawing shows esmolol hydrochloride, read as follows.

- **Amine end:** an isopropyl group (H3C–CH(CH3)–) is bonded to an NH.
- **Linker:** the NH connects to CH2, then CH(OH), then CH2, then O.
- **Ring:** the O is attached to a para-substituted benzene ring.
- **Ester chain:** the other ring position carries CH2CH2C(=O)OCH3.
- **Salt:** HCl is written beside the structure, so it appears as a separate component.

All bonds in the drawing are plain, with no wedges or hashes, so the CH(OH) carbon gets no stereo marking.

SMILES: CC(C)NCC(O)COc1ccc(CCC(=O)OC)cc1.Cl
